description: Mapa da Logística de Energia - 2006 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). O mapa apresenta uma completa visualização da infraestrutura pertinente à logistica do setor energético brasileiro. apoiado por textos básicos da proposta de Política Nacional de Ordenamento Territorial - Logistica e Ordenação do Território O mapeamento foi baseado no Balanço Energético Nacional (BEN) 2005 - Agencia Nacional do Petróleo (ANP), Petrobrás, Operador Nacional do Sistema (ONS) ... Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Logistica, Energia Elétrica, Petróleo, Biomassa. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
